```{r}


# --- 1) Clean text and convert Booking.Value to numeric ---
df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ {
    x <- as.character(.)
    x <- str_trim(x)
    x[x %in% c("null", "NULL", "", "NaN", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
    x
  })) %>%
  mutate(
    Booking.Value.num = parse_number(Booking.Value),
    Incomplete.Rides.num = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Incomplete.Rides))
  )

# --- 2) Create status group ---
if ("Booking.Status" %in% names(df_clean)) {
  df_clean <- df_clean %>%
    mutate(status_group = if_else(
      str_to_title(Booking.Status) == "Completed",
      "Completed", "Cancelled/Other"
    ))
} else {
  df_clean <- df_clean %>%
    mutate(status_group = if_else(
      !is.na(Incomplete.Rides.num) & Incomplete.Rides.num > 0,
      "Cancelled/Other", "Completed"
    ))
}

# --- 3) Compute revenue realized vs lost ---
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    revenue_realized = if_else(status_group == "Completed", Booking.Value.num, 0),
    revenue_lost     = if_else(status_group != "Completed", Booking.Value.num, 0)
  )

# --- 4) Summarize totals ---
rev_summary <- df_clean %>%
  summarise(
    `Revenue Realized (Completed)` = sum(revenue_realized, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Revenue Lost (Cancelled)`     = sum(revenue_lost,     na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "type", values_to = "revenue")

print(rev_summary)

# --- 5) Plot with revenue labels ---
p1 <- ggplot(rev_summary, aes(x = type, y = revenue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E86C1", width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  geom_text(
    aes(label = dollar(revenue)),
    vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Revenue Realized vs Revenue Lost",
    subtitle = "Based on Completed vs Cancelled Bookings",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total Revenue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p1)

ggsave(
  filename = "revenue_realized_vs_lost.png",  
  plot = p1,                                  
  width = 8, height = 5,                     
  dpi = 300                                  
)
```

```{r}
df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(
    `Payment.Method` = str_trim(as.character(`Payment.Method`)),
    `Payment.Method` = na_if(`Payment.Method`, "null"),
    `Payment.Method` = na_if(`Payment.Method`, "NULL"),
    `Booking.Value` = as.numeric(`Booking.Value`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Payment.Method`))

# Summarize total revenue by payment type
revenue_summary <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(`Payment.Method`) %>%
  summarise(total_revenue = sum(`Booking.Value`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_revenue))

# Plot without null values
p2 <- ggplot(revenue_summary, aes(x = `Payment.Method`, y = total_revenue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E86C1") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = dollar(total_revenue)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Revenue by Payment Method",
    x = "Payment Method",
    y = "Total Revenue"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

print(p2)

ggsave(
  filename = "total_revenue_by_payment_method.png",  
  plot = p2,                                  
  width = 8, height = 5,                     
  dpi = 300                                  
)
```

```{r}
# ---------- 1) Normalize columns (handles spaces vs. dots + "null") ----------
df1 <- df %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- as.character(.)
    x <- str_trim(x)
    x[x %in% c("null","NULL","","NaN","NA","N/A","-",".")] <- NA_character_
    x
  })) %>%
  mutate(
    vehicle_type = coalesce(`Vehicle.Type`, Vehicle.Type),
    booking_value = parse_number(coalesce(`Booking.Value`, Booking.Value)),
    distance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coalesce(`Ride.Distance`, Ride.Distance))),
    booking_status = str_to_title(coalesce(`Booking.Status`, Booking.Status))
  ) %>%
  mutate(completed = !is.na(booking_status) & booking_status == "Completed")

# ---------- 2) Aggregate per vehicle type ----------
vehicle_tbl <- df1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(vehicle_type)) %>%
  group_by(vehicle_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_booking  = sum(booking_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    success_booking = sum(if_else(completed, booking_value, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_distance   = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_distance = sum(distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_booking)) %>%
  mutate(icon = case_when(
    str_detect(str_to_lower(vehicle_type), "mini")   ~ "🚗",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(vehicle_type), "sedan")  ~ "🚙",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(vehicle_type), "xl|suv") ~ "🚐",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(vehicle_type), "auto|tuk") ~ "🛺",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(vehicle_type), "bike")   ~ "🛵",
    TRUE ~ "🚕"
  )) %>%
  mutate(vehicle_display = paste(icon, vehicle_type)) %>%
  select(
    vehicle_display,
    total_booking, success_booking, avg_distance, total_distance
  )

# ---------- 3) Build gt table that looks like your mockup ----------
gt_tbl <- vehicle_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    vehicle_display = "Vehicle Type",
    total_booking   = "Total Booking\nvalue",
    success_booking = "Success Booking\nvalue",
    avg_distance    = "Avg Distance\nTravelled",
    total_distance  = "Total Distance\nTravelled"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = avg_distance, decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = total_distance, suffixing = TRUE, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(total_booking, success_booking), suffixing = TRUE, decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Vehicle Performance Summary**")) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(16),
    data_row.padding = px(8),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    heading.title.font.size = px(22)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "all", color = "grey40", weight = px(1)),
    locations = list(cells_body(), cells_column_labels())
  )

gt_tbl
```

```{r}
SAVE   <- FALSE            
OUTDIR <- "charts"
if (SAVE && !dir.exists(OUTDIR)) dir.create(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE)

# =========================
# 1) Feature engineering
# =========================
Date_col <- dplyr::coalesce(df$Date, df$`Date`)
Time_col <- dplyr::coalesce(df$Time, df$`Time`)

dt_chr <- str_trim(paste0(Date_col, " ", Time_col))
dt     <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(dt_chr,
                                           orders = c("Ymd HMS","Y-m-d H:M:S",
                                                      "m/d/Y H:M:S","d/m/Y H:M:S",
                                                      "Ymd HM","Y-m-d H:M",
                                                      "m/d/Y H:M","d/m/Y H:M"),
                                           tz = "UTC"))

df1 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    .dt   = dt,
    hour  = hour(.dt),
    dow   = wday(.dt, week_start = 1) - 1,    
    month = month(.dt),
    weekday_name = factor(weekdays(.dt),
                          levels = c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday",
                                     "Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")),
    month_name = factor(months(.dt),
                        levels = month.name)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hour), !is.na(dow), !is.na(month))

# =========================
# 2) Cancellation flag
# =========================
status <- str_trim(as.character(dplyr::coalesce(df1$`Booking.Status`, df1$Booking.Status)))

COMPLETED_LABEL <- "Completed"
CANCEL_SET <- c("Cancelled by Driver",
                "Cancelled by Customer",
                "No Driver Found",
                "Incomplete")

df1 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(is_cancelled = status %in% CANCEL_SET)

# =========================
# 3) Aggregation helpers
# =========================
count_rate <- function(data, key) {
  data %>%
    group_by({{ key }}) %>%
    summarise(
      total   = n(),
      cancels = sum(is_cancelled, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(cancel_rate = as.numeric(cancels) / pmax(total, 1) * 100)
}

by_hour  <- count_rate(df1, hour) %>% arrange(hour)

by_week  <- count_rate(df1, weekday_name) %>%
  mutate(weekday_name = fct_relevel(weekday_name,
                                    "Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday",
                                    "Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")) %>%
  arrange(weekday_name)

by_month <- count_rate(df1, month_name) %>%
  mutate(month_name = fct_relevel(month_name, month.name)) %>%
  arrange(month_name) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total))

# =========================
# 4) Plot helper
# =========================
bar_plot <- function(dat, x, y, title, xlabel, ylabel, rotation = 0, fname = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes({{ x }}, {{ y }})) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2E86C1") +
    labs(title = title, x = xlabel, y = ylabel) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = rotation, hjust = ifelse(rotation==0, 0.5, 1))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_si("")),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    )
  if (SAVE && !is.null(fname)) ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, fname), p, dpi = 150, width = 9, height = 5)
  p
}

# =========================
# 5) COUNT charts
# =========================
bar_plot(by_hour,  hour, cancels,
         "Cancellations by Hour (Count)", "Hour (0–23)", "Cancellations",
         rotation = 0, fname = "cxl_count_by_hour.png")

bar_plot(by_week,  weekday_name, cancels,
         "Cancellations by Weekday (Count)", "Weekday", "Cancellations",
         rotation = 0, fname = "cxl_count_by_weekday.png")

bar_plot(by_month, month_name, cancels,
         "Cancellations by Month (Count)", "Month", "Cancellations",
         rotation = 45, fname = "cxl_count_by_month.png")

# =========================
# 6) RATE charts (%)
# =========================
bar_plot(by_hour,  hour, cancel_rate,
         "Cancellation Rate by Hour (%)", "Hour (0–23)", "Rate (%)",
         rotation = 0, fname = "cxl_rate_by_hour.png")

bar_plot(by_week,  weekday_name, cancel_rate,
         "Cancellation Rate by Weekday (%)", "Weekday", "Rate (%)",
         rotation = 0, fname = "cxl_rate_by_weekday.png")

bar_plot(by_month, month_name, cancel_rate,
         "Cancellation Rate by Month (%)", "Month", "Rate (%)",
         rotation = 45, fname = "cxl_rate_by_month.png")

# =========================
# 7) Heatmap: cancellation RATE (weekday × hour)
# =========================
rate_grid <- df1 %>%
  group_by(weekday_name, hour) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(is_cancelled, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(weekday_name = factor(c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"),
                                 levels = c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")),
           hour = 0:23)

p_heat <- ggplot(rate_grid, aes(x = hour, y = weekday_name, fill = rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "Cancellation Rate (%)", low = "#f0f9e8", high = "#08589e", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Cancellation Rate Heatmap (%): Weekday × Hour",
       x = "Hour (0–23)", y = "Weekday") +
  theme_minimal()
if (SAVE) ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, "cxl_rate_heatmap_weekday_by_hour.png"),
                 p_heat, dpi = 150, width = 10, height = 5)
p_heat


ggsave(
  filename = "cancellation_rate_heatmap.png",  
  plot = p_heat,                                  
  width = 8, height = 5,                     
  dpi = 300                                  
)
```
